popCulture.title: Iphis
popCulture.description: Daughter of Ligdus raised as a son — Ovid's Cretan girl who loves Ianthe and becomes a man by Isis' gift.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book IX holds the vow, the deception, and the wedding-eve transformation — still the classic sex-change myth of antiquity.
